operations.name: Abort Copy Blob
operations.notes: Copies complete synchronously, so no copy is ever pending. Aborting a completed copy with its matching ID returns 409 NoPendingCopyOperation with request correlation; a different ID returns CopyIdMismatch.

operations.name: Append Block
operations.notes: Up to 100 MiB per block at the 2023-11-03 baseline and 50,000 blocks, with Content-MD5 or CRC64, maximum-size and append-position guards, leases, and offset and committed block count headers. Bearer recordings B-10 and B-18 check small appends and guard failures, not the version-specific block size limit.

operations.name: Append Block From URL
operations.notes: The 2023-11-03 Bearer cassette replays a same-account HTTPS source with explicit source authorization, checks offset and block count, and reads back appended bytes. The local source Bearer header is not forwarded to a remote host. x-ms-source-content-md5 or -crc64 is compared with the bytes read from the source window before anything is appended. A mismatch answers 400 Md5Mismatch or Crc64Mismatch and changes nothing, and both headers together answer 400 InvalidHeaderValue (ADR-0036). The mismatch codes are unverified against Azure until B-47 is recorded.

operations.name: Copy Blob
operations.notes: Sources on this listener (path-style or host-style URLs); other hosts answer NotImplemented unless the operator allowlists them with --allow-external-copy-sources (ADR-0024), in which case the source is fetched synchronously with SSRF guards. Completes synchronously with x-ms-copy-status: success and a copy id. The source may name a snapshot or version of a block blob and can be read with same-account Shared Key or bearer credentials, a read SAS on the source URL, or public access. Copy properties preserve the source scheme and omit the query. Source and destination conditions and leases apply. Block blob bytes are copied rather than shared; page and append blob copies keep their type and share extents, and a copied append blob is unsealed unless x-ms-seal-blob: true seals it (ADR-0036); that header on a page or block blob source answers 400 InvalidHeaderValue and copies nothing. Whether Azure seals a copy of a sealed source by default, and the code for the refusal, are unverified until B-48 is recorded. Incremental copy is a separate operation.

operations.name: Create Container
operations.notes: Accepts x-ms-meta-* and x-ms-blob-public-access. $web, $root, and $logs can be created like any container; Azuifer writes nothing into $logs. A service SAS cannot create containers.

operations.name: Delete Blob
operations.notes: Deletes the current blob, a snapshot, or a version; x-ms-delete-snapshots include or only, otherwise SnapshotsPresent (Azure's code is BlobHasSnapshots). Requires the lease id while leased and supports conditions. Honors the account delete retention (soft delete, evaluated lazily against the clock) and versioning. Page and append blobs follow the same soft delete, version, and snapshot rules as block blobs. A legal hold or unexpired immutability policy refuses the delete. Deletes are synchronous. On an HNS account a directory with children answers 409 DirectoryIsNotEmpty ("This operation is not permitted on a non-empty directory."), the code and message public AzCopy and SDK reports show for Azure; no recording of it exists here.

operations.name: Delete Blob Immutability Policy
operations.notes: Removes an unlocked or expired policy. A locked, unexpired policy is refused.

operations.name: Delete Container
operations.notes: Deletes immediately and requires the lease id while a lease is active. With a DeleteRetentionPolicy on the account (one setting governs blob and container soft delete here; Azure keeps a separate container setting in the management plane) the container is kept under a hidden name for the retention days on the injected clock and can be restored. Azure's asynchronous deletion window (ContainerBeingDeleted) is not modeled.

operations.name: Find Blobs by Tags
operations.notes: Account and container scope with AND-joined comparisons (=, >, >=, <, <=) over quoted tag names and @container; results are immediately consistent and cover current blobs only.

operations.name: Get Account Information
operations.notes: GET and HEAD at service, container, and blob scope return fixed values for SKU (Standard_LRS) and kind (StorageV2). The HNS flag reflects local account configuration. B-41 checks the flat StorageV2 Bearer profile, not other SKUs or account kinds.

operations.name: Get Blob
operations.notes: Reads the current blob, a snapshot (snapshot), or a version (versionid), with a single byte range (Range or x-ms-range), x-ms-range-get-content-md5 and -crc64 up to 4 MiB, all four conditions, x-ms-if-tags, lease id, and service SAS response-header overrides. B-12 verifies the CRC-64/NVME checksum on a recorded block-blob range, not all checksum or history profiles. Page blob holes read as zeros and append blobs return their concatenated blocks. Archived blobs answer BlobArchived. Downloading an incremental copy base returns 409 OperationNotAllowedOnIncrementalCopyBlob; the copied snapshots remain readable. Reports x-ms-version-id, x-ms-is-current-version, and x-ms-tag-count. Metadata names are returned in lowercase.

operations.name: Get Blob Metadata
operations.notes: GET and HEAD with comp=metadata, conditions, and an optional lease id. Metadata names are returned in lowercase.

operations.name: Get Blob Properties
operations.notes: Returns content headers, metadata, creation time, lease, copy, access tier, and tag count for the current blob, a snapshot, or a version. Reports the blob type and, for page and append blobs, the sequence number, committed block count, and sealed state. Metadata names are returned in lowercase.

operations.name: Get Blob Service Properties
operations.notes: Returns stored logging, metrics, CORS, default service version, delete retention, and static website settings (ADR-0019). B-41 checks one flat Bearer profile with empty CORS and disabled retention and website, not the defaults for a new Azure account or configured feature behavior.

operations.name: Get Blob Service Stats
operations.notes: Answered only on the {account}-secondary host, as in Azure, with GeoReplication always live and the current time as the last sync time. The primary endpoint is rejected; the exact error code there is unverified.

operations.name: Get Blob Tags
operations.notes: Reads the tags of the current blob or a version; x-ms-if-tags and lease id are honored. Snapshots do not support tags.

operations.name: Get Block List
operations.notes: Committed, uncommitted, or all blocks of the current blob, or the committed blocks of a snapshot or version (snapshot and versionid parameters). Supports conditions and an optional lease id. Page and append blobs answer InvalidBlobType.

operations.name: Get Container ACL
operations.notes: Returns stored access policies and x-ms-blob-public-access. Never available anonymously.

operations.name: Get Container Metadata
operations.notes: GET and HEAD with comp=metadata return metadata without lease properties; anonymous access requires container-level public access. Metadata names are returned in lowercase because the HTTP layer folds header case.

operations.name: Get Container Properties
operations.notes: Returns ETag, Last-Modified, metadata, lease headers, and public access. Anonymous access requires container-level public access. Encryption scope and immutability headers carry fixed values.

operations.name: Get Page Ranges
operations.notes: Lists allocated ranges with a byte window, marker, and maxresults; touching ranges merge. Unpaged listings omit NextMarker. B-17 checks ordinary and bounded listings, and B-24 compares the changed-range result between two incremental copy snapshots. ClearRange, paging of diffs and other snapshot profiles remain unverified against Azure.

operations.name: Get User Delegation Key
operations.notes: Requires a bearer token (--oauth basic or jwks) and returns a generated 32-byte key valid for at most seven days. Keys are held in memory, so a restart invalidates every user-delegation SAS.

operations.name: Incremental Copy Blob
operations.notes: Same-instance page blob snapshots only; each copy must name a newer snapshot of the same source. The 2023-11-03 Bearer cassette uses a user delegation SAS on the source and checks 202 pending, the copy ID, a readable destination snapshot and the range diff between two copies. Azuifer completes the copy synchronously, so HEAD already reports success and there is no abortable copy or cross-instance copy.

operations.name: Lease Blob
operations.notes: Acquire, renew, change, release, and break per the state table in ADR-0017, with the Azure lease error codes. Every mutating blob operation checks x-ms-lease-id; reads and Set Blob Tier accept an optional id that must match. Supports ETag and date conditions. Leases on snapshots and versions are not modeled.

operations.name: Lease Container
operations.notes: Acquire, renew, change, release, and break with durations 15 to 60 seconds or infinite and break periods 0 to 60 (ADR-0017). Expiry is evaluated lazily against the injected clock. Only the date conditions apply.

operations.name: List Blobs
operations.notes: Flat and hierarchical (delimiter with BlobPrefix) listings with prefix, marker, maxresults, and include of metadata, copy, uncommittedblobs, snapshots, versions, deleted, and tags; snapshots, versions, deleted, and tags cannot be combined with uncommittedblobs. Within a name, snapshots and versions list oldest first and the current blob last. Reports BlobType and, for page and append blobs, the sequence number and sealed state. Blob ETags in the XML are unquoted. Uncommitted blobs list with minimal properties. The permissions include answers NotImplemented. Anonymous access requires container-level public access. Markers are opaque local tokens; a nonempty request marker is echoed in the response.

operations.name: List Containers
operations.notes: Supports prefix, marker, maxresults, and include=metadata,deleted; the listing carries lease state and public access. include=system answers NotImplemented. Markers are opaque local tokens, and a nonempty request marker is echoed in the response.

operations.name: Preflight Blob Request
operations.notes: OPTIONS answered at the HTTP edge from the account's stored CORS rules; Access-Control-* headers are added to matching requests. A preflight that no rule allows answers 403 CorsPreflightFailure, an error code not yet verified against Azure.

operations.name: Put Blob
operations.notes: Block, page, and append blobs (x-ms-blob-type). Supports content headers, x-ms-blob-content-md5, metadata, access tier, lease, x-ms-tags, and all conditions; If-None-Match: * on an existing blob is BlobAlreadyExists. The single-request limit defaults to 256 MiB (--max-blob-bytes). Page blobs are sparse up to 8 TiB, are created with Content-Length 0, and carry a sequence number; append blobs start empty and refuse access tiers. An overwrite retires the old state as a version (accounts in --versioning-accounts) or a soft-deleted snapshot (delete retention enabled). Reports x-ms-request-server-encrypted: false. Encryption scopes and immutability headers are unsupported. A SAS with only the create permission may overwrite.

operations.name: Put Blob From URL
operations.notes: B-23 verifies a full same-account HTTPS copy with x-ms-copy-source-authorization and request properties. x-ms-copy-source-blob-properties selects source or request properties, and x-ms-copy-source-tag-option can copy tags. Source conditions apply. Tag behavior is not covered by the cassette; encryption is unsupported. x-ms-source-content-md5 is compared with the source bytes before the blob is written (400 Md5Mismatch, nothing created; unverified against Azure until B-47 is recorded). x-ms-source-content-crc64 is refused with NotImplemented because Azure documents no source CRC64 header for this operation (ADR-0036).

operations.name: Put Block
operations.notes: Per-block limit defaults to 5000 MiB (--max-block-bytes). Staged blocks survive restart and require the lease id while the blob is leased. A block ID width that conflicts with staged IDs returns InvalidBlobOrBlock. Azure's staging expiration is not modeled. Page and append blobs answer InvalidBlobType.

operations.name: Put Block From URL
operations.notes: The 2023-11-03 Bearer cassette stages a range from a same-account HTTPS source using explicit source authorization, commits it, and reads the selected bytes. x-ms-source-content-md5 or -crc64 is compared with the bytes read from the source window before the block is staged. A mismatch answers 400 Md5Mismatch or Crc64Mismatch and changes nothing, and both headers together answer 400 InvalidHeaderValue (ADR-0036). The mismatch codes are unverified against Azure until B-47 is recorded.

operations.name: Put Block List
operations.notes: Committed, Uncommitted, and Latest selections with content headers, metadata, tier, x-ms-tags, lease, and conditions. The assembled-blob limit is configurable (--max-assembled-blob-bytes, default 512 MiB), not Azure's 190.7 TiB. Versions and soft-deleted snapshots follow Put Blob. Page and append blobs answer InvalidBlobType.

operations.name: Put Page
operations.notes: Update and clear of 512-byte-aligned ranges, 4 MiB per update, Content-MD5 or crc64, sequence-number conditions, and leases. An unaligned range returns InvalidHeaderValue with the rejected range. Each update stores a new extent, so partly overwritten extents stay until fully replaced.

operations.name: Put Page From URL
operations.notes: The 2023-11-03 Bearer cassette writes a range from a same-account HTTPS source using explicit source authorization, verifies sparse read-back, and rejects a source range past EOF with 416 CannotVerifyCopySource. x-ms-source-content-md5 or -crc64 is compared with the bytes read from the source window before any page is written. A mismatch answers 400 Md5Mismatch or Crc64Mismatch and changes nothing, and both headers together answer 400 InvalidHeaderValue (ADR-0036). The mismatch codes are unverified against Azure until B-47 is recorded.

operations.name: Query Blob Contents
operations.notes: A SQL subset (SELECT, WHERE, LIMIT, comparisons, LIKE, IN, BETWEEN, CAST, a few string functions, and COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX without GROUP BY) over delimited text and JSON lines, answered as an Avro stream. Small bearer CSV/JSON queries, empty results, projection conversion errors, invalid SQL and malformed XML are covered by Azure cassettes at the baseline. The whole blob is read into memory, and other SQL, serialization, progress cadence and runtime error cases remain unverified. Arrow and Parquet answer NotImplemented.

operations.name: Rename Container
operations.notes: Unsupported. The 2023-11-03 flat Bearer cassette records 400 InvalidQueryParameterValue with comp=rename in the XML details.

operations.name: Resize Page Blob
operations.notes: Set Blob Properties with x-ms-blob-content-length; B-17 verifies shrink and grow with discard and zero-fill read-back. Azure's premium tier size constraints are not modeled, and resize with retained history is not covered by this recording.

operations.name: Restore Container
operations.notes: PUT restype=container&comp=undelete with x-ms-deleted-container-name and x-ms-deleted-container-version restores a soft-deleted container under the same or a new name. Soft delete is tied to the account DeleteRetentionPolicy. List Containers include=deleted reports Deleted, Version, DeletedTime, and RemainingRetentionDays.

operations.name: Seal Append Blob
operations.notes: B-18 verifies conditional seal on a flat append blob: 200, changed ETag, sealed flag, and 409 BlobIsSealed on another append without changing the existing bytes. Sealing an already sealed blob is idempotent locally. This does not cover versioning or soft delete. Copy Blob seals its destination with x-ms-seal-blob (see Copy Blob); Append Block has no seal header.

operations.name: Set Blob Expiry
operations.notes: x-ms-expiry-option RelativeToCreation, RelativeToNow, Absolute, or NeverExpire. Expiry is evaluated lazily against the injected clock (ADR-0022) and removes the blob and its snapshots at the deadline. Get, Head, and List Blobs report the expiry time.

operations.name: Set Blob Immutability Policy
operations.notes: Time-based policy in Unlocked or Locked mode on the current blob. Does not change the ETag. While a policy or legal hold applies, writes, property changes, and deletes are refused. Policies on snapshots and versions and container-level immutability are unsupported.

operations.name: Set Blob Legal Hold
operations.notes: x-ms-legal-hold true or false on the current blob; a hold blocks writes and deletes until cleared. Holds on snapshots and versions are unsupported.

operations.name: Set Blob Metadata
operations.notes: Replaces all metadata and changes the ETag. Requires the lease id while leased. Metadata names are validated and stored in lowercase.

operations.name: Set Blob Properties
operations.notes: Replaces all six content properties when any is supplied, clearing the rest; with none supplied the content properties are unchanged. Requires the lease id while leased. Resize Page Blob and Update Sequence Number use the same operation on a page blob.

operations.name: Set Blob Service Properties
operations.notes: Updates only the elements present in the request, validating CORS rules (at most five). Logging, metrics, retention, and static website settings are stored but not acted on.

operations.name: Set Blob Tags
operations.notes: Replaces the tags of the current blob or a version; enforces ten tags, 128 and 256 character limits, permitted characters, and x-ms-if-tags. Tag errors use the codes TagsTooLarge and InvalidTag.

operations.name: Set Blob Tier
operations.notes: Stores Hot, Cool, Cold, or Archive for block blobs and P4 to P80 for page blobs (stored and reported only). The bearer cassette verifies Cool and rejection of a premium tier on a block blob with a correlated InvalidHeaderValue and header echo. Leaving Archive answers 202 but completes at once, with no rehydration priority or pending state. Archived blobs cannot be read (BlobArchived).

operations.name: Set Container ACL
operations.notes: Stores up to five signed identifiers and the public access level (ADR-0019). Omitting x-ms-blob-public-access makes the container private. Policy times and permission letters are validated.

operations.name: Set Container Metadata
operations.notes: Replaces all metadata and changes the ETag. Supports x-ms-lease-id (optional, must match an active lease) and If-Modified-Since or If-Unmodified-Since.

operations.name: Snapshot Blob
operations.notes: Creates a snapshot that shares the blob's extent; metadata override, conditions, x-ms-if-tags, and lease id are honored. The in-memory backend copies the bytes. A snapshot does not receive its own version id.

operations.name: Static website request
operations.notes: GET and HEAD on {account}.web.{domain} of the Blob listener read the $web container using the account's index document and 404 document; other methods are 405. Responses are approximations of Azure's: the HTML error pages differ, and defaultIndexDocumentPath, custom domains and the z13 host form are not served.

operations.name: Submit Batch
operations.notes: Delete Blob or Set Blob Tier subrequests, one kind per batch, at most 256, account or container scope; each subrequest is authenticated and authorized separately and reported with its own status. Container-scoped Bearer recordings cover independent success and missing-blob responses. A mixed delete/tier batch returns an embedded 400 AllBatchSubRequestsShouldBeSameApi in an outer 202; an empty envelope or truncated part returns embedded InvalidInput. Rejected envelopes execute no subrequests.

operations.name: Undelete Blob
operations.notes: Restores a soft-deleted blob with its tags and soft-deleted snapshots and versions until the retention days elapse. Retention starts when the delete is received and is checked on each request.

operations.name: Update Sequence Number
operations.notes: B-17 verifies max, update and increment on a flat page blob through Set Blob Properties, including the returned sequence number and a changed ETag. The parser enforces the action's required or forbidden numeric header and signed 64-bit bounds. Live overflow and other profiles are not covered.
